summary: Tested new Leads feature end-to-end. Backend (8/8 endpoint tests) and public LandingPage / LeadPage flows work correctly. AdminPage CRASHES immediately after login with 'fetchLeads is not defined' — the Leads tab and the Quotes tab are unusable.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught ReferenceError: fetchLeads is not defined. Called inside useEffect (line ~170) and on the refresh button (line ~298). Function is NEVER declared in the file. This makes the WHOLE admin dashboard unusable (white-screen / red error overlay) right after a successful login.
deleteLead(lead.id) is referenced on the per-row delete button (line ~571) but never defined. Even after fixing fetchLeads, clicking Delete on a lead row will throw a ReferenceError.

integration_issues.flow: Admin → Leads tab → see saved leads
integration_issues.issue: Cannot be verified in the UI because the page crashes on mount. Backend GET /api/admin/leads is fully working (verified via API tests).

action_items: Define fetchLeads() in AdminPage.js — GET ${API}/admin/leads with Authorization header, setLeads(res.data), handle error toast.
Define deleteLead(leadId) in AdminPage.js — confirm + DELETE ${API}/admin/leads/${leadId} with auth header, then call fetchLeads().
After fix, retest: login → Leads tab → leads-table renders → Open link goes to /lead/{id} → Delete removes a row.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.js references two functions that are not defined (fetchLeads, deleteLead). This is a hard runtime error and should have been caught before shipping. Add an ErrorBoundary at the route level so a single broken page does not blank the dashboard.
Backend Lead model uses secrets.token_urlsafe(8) which is good (≈11 chars, unguessable, url-safe). GET /api/leads/{id} correctly excludes _id from response.

LandingPage handleTextBen builds a sms: URI and does window.location.href = smsHref — this is fine for mobile but cannot be auto-completed in a headless browser; the lead IS persisted to backend first (verified).
test_credentials: Admin Basic Auth: admin / bensroadservice2024 (verified working at backend level).
seed_data_creation: Test leads created with TEST_ prefix are auto-cleaned via pytest fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent defines fetchLeads + deleteLead in /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.js, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_leads.py (should still be 8/8) and then UI-test: navigate to /admin, login admin/bensroadservice2024, click leads-tab-btn (data-testid), verify leads-table renders, and click an 'Open' link to confirm /lead/{id} loads with lead-name, lead-distance, lead-call-cta.
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: AdminPage.js was updated to add a Leads tab UI (button, table, rows with Open/Delete) and a useEffect call to fetchLeads(), but the implementation functions fetchLeads() and deleteLead() were never added to the component. As soon as the user logs in, useEffect fires fetchLeads() → ReferenceError → React unmounts the tree and shows the runtime-error overlay. REPRODUCTION: open /admin, enter admin / bensroadservice2024, click Login → red 'fetchLeads is not defined' screen. MITIGATION: add the two functions (mirroring fetchQuotes/deleteQuote patterns) using the existing authHeader and ${API}/admin/leads endpoints.
